title: 지정재판부의 구성과 운영에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1

Article 2 (Composition)
(1) The Constitutional Court shall have Panel No. 1, Panel No. 2, and Panel No. 3. <Amended on April 17, 1998>
(2) Each Panel shall consist of three Justices of the Constitutional Court. <Amended on December 3, 1991>
